author: Arnav
problem: Read N integers. Print the largest even number that is the sum of two elements at different positions, or -1 if no such sum exists.
bug_description: Also tries the top odd plus the top even, which is always odd, so it can print an odd sum.

comments.accurate: Takes the best of the two largest evens and the two largest odds, since only same-parity pairs give an even sum
comments.wrong_behavior: Tries the top odd with the top even, the top two odds and the top two evens, and prints the largest sum
comments.wrong_location: Pair candidates verified; check the sentinel values are small enough to never win

source.buggy_line: print(max(odd[-1] + even[-1], odd[-1] + odd[-2], even[-1] + even[-2], -1))
